display_name: DURA 源接收机均衡七景测试
description: 归一化 DURA 全局修正，源训练按公开接收机频率反比均衡，不在推理时使用 RX。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU2, FP32 TF32 off deterministic source training; CPU ground

data.representation: frozen candidate + frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on fixed Phase1 seven-view ground IQ
data.physical_ids_ref: 168000 fixed Phase1 Main split ground physical records in each of seven views
data.tx_sets_ref: No target labels, clean pair, or target fitting during inference; labels only after all seven predictions

roles.L_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.test: fixed Phase1 ground IQ, truth last

data.validation_ref: Seven fixed predictions precede independent truth-last scoring
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Recovery training uses paired source IQ only; no F outputs, F weights, TX labels, V or target. Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only after recovery checkpoint frozen.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record Phase1 IQ only after source training; no target fit, truth only after seven-view predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed repeatedly observed Phase1 simulated ground test; not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA v1.0 plus independently initialized 14793858-parameter zero-output global/local correction
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed original DURA source provenance and exact source context fit IDs; no F/TX/V/target in training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original frozen DURA and matching legal source IQ context; no prior candidate checkpoint
checkpoint.selection_rule: Final epoch 20 fixed, no source pilot or target based selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU2: one this-run GPU worker; >=4096 MiB free and fewer than three total compute apps; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: independent CPU subprocess ground score after seven complete predictions

rows.method: Normalized DURA with inverse-frequency source receiver weighting
rows.purpose: Balance source receiver contributions without target receiver routing
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026110612; source fit 2026110611; order 2026110613; fixed evaluation 2026092701.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views
rows.budget_ref: 168000 ground records x seven views; fixed predictions before independent truth-last

notes: Fresh zero-output normalized correction from fixed DURA; no F/TX/V/target training data.
Only public RX metadata for legal source L_s/U_s fit IDs determines inverse-frequency weights; each of five source RX contributes equal total sample weight.
Fixed source RX counts 1:8262, 3:8182, 4:5458, 6:5341, 8:5525; three view-major weights repeat the same source ID weight.
32768 source IDs x three views, batch32, AdamW .0003, fixed 20 epochs; original and this objective have same exposure and update budget.
Eleven focused tests, real-source DURA six-step GPU smoke with aligned RX weights, independent P0/P1 review passed.
Inference never reads RX; Tri-SIG-TIME SSL seven-view ground predictions precede independent truth-last and target scores do not guide fitting.
